_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from U.S. Department of Justice releases, a Kenyan High Court ruling, and subsequent sentencing reports. The Akasha Organization is the named Kenyan network; external supplier Hafeez and external transport associate Hussein are shown as connected people without assigning them membership. Charges and alleged roles are expressly labeled; no later disposition for Goswami or Hussein was established in the reviewed public sources. Country-level historical associations only; no precise locations, operational routes, enforcement gaps, or photos without verified reuse rights.
